Over 37,000 died on highway 'black corridors' in three years

Official data indicates that over 37,000 people lost their lives on 6,358 identified "black corridors" along national highways in India over a three-year period. Tamil Nadu has the highest number of these accident-prone zones. The data was presented by the Centre, highlighting a significant road safety concern.
